title: Odoodee language
extract: Odoodee (Ododei) is a Trans–New Guinea language of New Guinea, spoken in the plains east of the Strickland River. It is also called Tomu, after the river along which it is found, and Nomad. It has two dialects, the Hesif dialect and the Kalamo dialect.
